title: Controversy Erupts After Bal Thackeray Image Torn at Protest

ai.summary: Shiv Sena members tore copies of Sonia Gandhi's memoir during a press conference, accidentally damaging a photograph of Bal Thackeray, leading to backlash from opposition parties including Shiv Sena (UBT), MNS, and Congress.

facts.claim: Shiv Sena members tore copies of Sonia Gandhi's memoir during a press conference
facts.quote: A significant protest occurred on Wednesday led by the Shiv Sena against Sonia Gandhi, following remarks in her memoir that discussed the actions of Hindutva ideologue Vinayak Damodar Savarkar.

facts.claim: accidentally damaged a photograph of Bal Thackeray
facts.quote: While performing this act, a paper featuring Bal Thackeray, the party's late founder, was inadvertently torn.

facts.claim: led to backlash from opposition parties including Shiv Sena (UBT), MNS, and Congress
facts.quote: Leaders from the opposition faction, the Shiv Sena (UBT), as well as Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) and Congress, condemned Shaina's actions.
